name: MuslimInk
author: fiqsr
changelog_id: Restorasi Pratinjau Font Jam Asli (Sesuai v1.1.7): Mengembalikan sistem render pratinjau font jam v1.1.7 yang terbukti stabil di perangkat fisik XTEINK X4 Pro dengan font scanline pre-compiled bawaan
Perbaikan Bug Crash / Freeze Modal Font: Mengeliminasi error render baris 2 (Klasik Serif) yang sebelumnya memotong tampilan dan menyebabkan baris lainnya hilang
Enam Gaya Font Jam Berfungsi Sempurna: Seluruh font (Modern Bulat, Klasik Serif, Tegas Bold, Geometris Slab, Artistik Inline, dan Angka Arab) tampil rapi, proporsional, dan lancar dipilih
Optimasi Paket OTA (<256 KB): Ukuran paket tetap berada di bawah batas 262.144 bytes sehingga update via OTA/In-App berjalan tanpa kendala memori
changelog_en: Restored Authentic Font Preview Engine (Matching v1.1.7): Reverted to the rock-solid v1.1.7 preview renderer using native pre-compiled TrueType scanlines verified on physical XTEINK X4 Pro hardware
Fixed Font Modal Freeze / Truncation Bug: Eliminated the row 2 (Classic Serif) rendering crash that previously truncated glyphs and hid remaining options
All 6 Clock Fonts 100% Operational: All styles (Modern Rounded, Classic Serif, Bold Geometric, Geometric Slab, Artistic Inline, and Arabic Numerals) render smoothly and are fully selectable
OTA Package Optimization (<256 KB): Cleanly fits under the strict 262,144 bytes OTA limit for smooth in-app firmware updating
